TWO INSTRUMENT TRAPS, both of which caught me and will catch the next critic. (1) UILayer repaints only when dirty and getCensusState()/censusAnswer() both call metrics() which repaints and clears it — a probe that calls renderedTextClear() AFTER reading state reports DTR 0 for a scene that drew everything. Use getRenderedText().next_index as a watermark taken BEFORE the repainting call. (2) ui.js wrap() splits prose on whitespace and DROPS the space, so a space-joined substring delivery test fails on every wrapped string and INVENTS undrawn text — it cost me 0.067 on DTR_scene and 0.133 on DTR_q. Strip all whitespace both sides. The builder's probe, W1-07-r3's probe and my first two drafts all used the space-joined test, so every DTR figure published before this verdict UNDERSTATES.
